title: Organising a park clean-up
instructionsHu: A barátaiddal szemétszedési napot szervezel a helyi parkban. Hívd meg az ír szomszédodat, mondd el a részleteket, és kérd meg, hogy segítsen. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You live in a small town in Hungary. You and some friends are organising a clean-up day in the local park next Saturday because there is a lot of rubbish there. Your new neighbour, who is from Ireland, has just come home, and you meet him in front of your house.
situation.candidateRole: You are one of the organisers of the clean-up day.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mr Kelly, your new Irish neighbour.
goals: Introduce yourself and explain what the clean-up day is and why you are organising it.
Tell him the date, the time and the meeting point.
Say what people should bring with them.
Ask him to help in some way, for example with his car or by telling other neighbours.
situation.examinerOpening: Hi there! You live next door, don't you? Nice to meet you.

followUpQuestions: A clean-up day? That sounds interesting. When and where is it?
Do I need to bring anything?
I'm busy on Saturday morning, I'm afraid. Is there any other way I can help?

usefulPhrases.en: We're organising a clean-up day in the park.
There's a lot of litter near the playground.
usefulPhrases.hu: Sok a szemét a játszótér körül.

usefulPhrases.en: We're meeting at the main gate at nine.
Please bring a pair of gloves.
It would be a great help.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Hi there! You live next door, don't you? Nice to meet you.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hi, nice to meet you too. I'm Bálint, and I live here with my parents. Actually, my friends and I are organising a clean-up day in the local park, because there's so much rubbish there: plastic bottles, bags, even old tyres.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: A clean-up day? That sounds interesting. When and where is it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It's next Saturday, from nine o'clock until about one. We're meeting at the main gate of the park, next to the playground.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do I need to bring anything?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, please bring a pair of gloves and some old clothes. We'll have rubbish bags, and the town council is giving us free sandwiches and drinks.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: I'm busy on Saturday morning, I'm afraid. Is there any other way I can help?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Oh, that's a pity. Well, you've got a car, haven't you? Could you take the full bags to the recycling centre in the afternoon? Or you could tell the other neighbours about the event.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Sure, I can do both. I'll come with the car at about two.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That's brilliant, thank you so much! I'll give you my phone number, so you can call me on Saturday.

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó bemutatkozik, elmondja, mi a szemétszedési nap és miért szervezik, megadja a dátumot, az időt és a találkozóhelyet, elmondja, mit kell hozni, végül kétféle segítséget is kér – minden szempont teljesül, a megadott sorrendben.
Szókincs: a környezetvédelem és a szervezés szavai pontosak (clean-up day, rubbish, main gate, rubbish bags, town council, recycling centre).

Nyelvhelyesség: a már eldöntött jövőbeli programot helyesen folyamatos jelen fejezi ki (We're meeting at the main gate), a kérést udvarias „Could you …?” kérdés, a „you've got a car, haven't you?” utókérdés is hibátlan.
Érdemes megtanulni: „my friends and I are organising …”, „Oh, that's a pity.”, „you've got a car, haven't you?”, „Could you take the full bags to the recycling centre?”.
